title: Using a Deep Learning-Based Decision Support System to Predict Emergent Large Vessel Occlusion Using Non-Contrast Computed Tomography.
summary: Deep-learning CT decision support is evaluated with readers for emergent large-vessel occlusion. Results reports reader diagnostic performance against the study reference standard; bounded to non-contrast CT and study cohort.
